study type: population-based cohort and nested case-control study
exposure: Time interval between AFE event and hysterectomy
cohort: All women diagnosed with amniotic-fluid embolism (AFE) in the UK between February 2005 and January 2014 (n = 120) and 3839 control women
finding: There was no significant temporal trend in the incidence of or risk factors for amniotic-fluid embolism over the study period.
